data.title: *Group* related work
data.subtitle: Usage tip 1 of 6. One task instead of several.

blocks.text: Anthropic's advice: **group related work into one task** instead of several.

items: Every step of a task **uses tokens**

blocks.text: Group **related** work only. Unrelated jobs go in a new conversation (tip 2).
In one task: read [file A], [file B] and [file C] in Inbox. Make [the one deliverable] that combines them. List where they disagree. Save it in Outputs.

blocks.old: Three tasks, each reading one file
blocks.new: One task: read three files, make one report
